Brand
Guidelines

Promo videos, cut from your repo.

Reelwright makes short promo videos for a project from its repo and its brand: square, vertical and landscape cuts with a voiceover, music and sound effects. It is a Claude Code plugin in the mtblck marketplace.

The mark is the three cuts it makes, drawn as frames on one centre: tall, wide, and the square in Tungsten.

Logo

01

Use the full logo wherever there is room, and the mark alone where space is small or square. On dark grounds use the dark version; where only one ink is available, use the one-colour logo in black or white.

Logo rules

02

Construction

On a 256 grid, band 16: a 9:16 frame of 117 × 208, the same frame turned 16:9, and a square of 149 whose inner edge meets the tall frame exactly. The dashed line is the clear space: 25 % of the mark’s height on every side, kept free of text and other graphics.

Minimum size

Below its minimum width, step down to the mark; below 32 px use the favicon.

One colour

Misuse

App and web icons

Files in icons/. Platforms round or mask the corners themselves; supply the square art as it is.

Promo videos, cut from your repo.

Headings are set in Familjen Grotesk at 700 with slightly tight spacing; body copy in Inter at 400, 16–18 px on screen and 10–12 pt in print, with a line height around 1.5. Keep lines to 60–75 characters. Both are free Google Fonts: load them from fonts.google.com or self-host the files.

Website colour

05

Every colour a website needs, made from the brand colours in OKLCH so steps of equal lightness look equal. Each scale has twelve steps, each with one job: 1–2 page and panel backgrounds, 3–5 component fills (rest, hover, pressed), 6–8 borders, 9–10 solid fills and their hover, 11–12 text. The brand colours themselves are kept exactly where they read.

Build with roles, not steps

Components use the named roles (--bg, --surface, --text, --text-muted, --brand with --on-brand, --border, --danger-subtle with --danger-text …). Each role has a light and a dark value, so dark mode follows the system on its own, or data-theme on the page forces either. Files in web/: palette.css, palette.tailwind.css for Tailwind v4, tokens.json (W3C Design Tokens) for Figma and Style Dictionary, and palette.html with every value.

Every pair in web/palette.html passes WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for edges). Lc is the APCA score from the WCAG 3 draft: 75 for body text, 60 for other text.

Email signature

06

Files in templates/email/. Host logo.png (set templates.email.logoUrl and export again), open signature.html in a browser, select all, copy and paste it into the mail client’s signature setting. signature.txt is the plain-text version.

One table with inline styles, so Gmail and Outlook keep it. The logo is the app-icon art on its own tile so it survives dark mode, and the text falls back to Arial where Familjen Grotesk isn’t installed. Keep it to name, role, contact and site: no quotes, banners or icon rows.

Business card

07

Size 3.5 × 2 in trim (85 × 55 mm in Europe), with 0.125 in bleed on every side: business-card.pdf is 3.75 × 2.25 in, one page per side, fonts embedded and the logo in vector. Keep text 0.25 in inside the trim.

Layout The front carries only the logo, on the brand colour; the back carries the person: name in Familjen Grotesk 10.5 pt, role and up to four contact lines at 7.5 pt, never under 6.5 pt. Order a proof: printers convert RGB to CMYK, so check the colour against the values on page 3.

Slides

08

Files in templates/slides/: an editable .pptx (each layout is a slide master with placeholders; opens in PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Slides) and a PDF. 16:9 with 0.75 in margins; titles in Familjen Grotesk 38 pt (54 on the title slide), body 22–24 pt and never under 18; six points at most. Brand colour on title, section and closing slides, paper behind content. The full logo opens and closes the deck; content slides carry only the small mark.

Social

09

Files in templates/social/, each with a -blank version (field, logo and bar, no text) for designing posts in Canva or Figma. One headline of eight words or fewer per image, the dark logo small in the top corner, the accent bar along the bottom. Stories keep text out of the top 250 and bottom 300 px, and the X header’s lower left sits under the profile picture. The portfolio cover is art with no words, drawn for the project; it is in portfolio/ with its phone version, icon and alt text.
